integrity: The mathematical proof and a standalone finite high-precision checker are included; independent mathematical validation is not asserted.
scientific_limitations: The fixed-B one-sided asymptotic does not cover B varying with epsilon, other parameter boundaries, or strong convergence of the rescaled signed measures. The invariant step-density representation is credited to Huang, Komorni and Zou. Numerical tests are finite corroboration. Historical priority against inaccessible generalized-beta papers is not exhaustively certified.
title: Sharp logarithmic boundary response for greedy double-base invariant measures
